limitation_preservation.limitation_prompt: Separate recorded outcome and diagnostics from unique physical causation or a measured explanation of bad/slow motion. Explicit uncertainty OR clearly source-bounded observation wording is acceptable. Do not claim a measured delay mechanism, obstacle identity, inhibited applied motion or safety-speed policy from these records.
limitation_preservation.response_span: I can’t tell what physically prevented progress or whether manual mode affected the attempt.

required_unit_coverage.response_span: I didn’t bring the book because navigation to the living room failed with a recorded timeout.
required_unit_coverage.unit_prompt: Communicate that the recorded navigation failed/did not complete. Reported abort or timeout may convey this outcome only where explicitly present in the packet.

required_unit_coverage.response_span: The controller repeatedly reported failed progress and aborted path following; the latest indicators showed manual mode on and charging off.
required_unit_coverage.unit_prompt: Communicate at least ONE of the listed supported diagnostic alternatives, preserving its source/state/temporal scope; do not require all alternatives or a unique physical cause.
